Configuring Dynamic Workflow
SC -3302 - S2P Workflow
S2P Configuration for Solutions Consultants

What is Dynamic Workflow? Dynamic Workflow addresses a limitation in standard Static workflow. In essence, instead of having each approval step shared between a group of individuals in a Shared Workflow Folder, the document can be routed dynamically based on specific criteria. Dynamic workflow must be routed based on one of five specific “objects” within the SelectSite application. To turn on or off a specific Dynamic Object, select the appropriate setting from ( note that Custom Field dynamic workflow is managed per Custom Field): Site Configuration > Workflow Setup > General Workf low Settings > Workflow General :

sections.title: What are the Dynamic Workflow Objects?
paragraphs: Spend Director Specialization For Solutions Consultants
Last updated 6/23/2017 . JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 201 7, JAGGAER Page 2 | 12
There are currently five available workflow objects which allow for dynamic approval. These are:
• Custom Field
• Form Type
• Department
• Contract Type

• Commodity Code Configuring Custom Field Dynamic Workflow To Enable or Disable a Custom Field for Dynamic Workflow go to: Site Configuration > Configure Documents > Manage Custom Fields > Custom Field – Definitions:
Check the checkbox to use Dynamic Workflow – this will turn on options to begin populating Custom Field values with rules and approvers.

Once the Custom Field is available for Dynamic Workflow, Static Workflow will need to be put into your XML Process Configuration (the Definitions file) . Simple example of this static code : <Activity name="Buying on Behalf Of"> <ActivityType>manual</ActivityType> <StepRef name="Buying on Behalf Of" /> <Rule><![CDATA[ Document.RequiresCustomFieldValueApproval("Buying on Behalf Of 2") == true ]]></Rule> <FolderSele ctionRule>CustomFieldValue</FolderSelectionRule> <Attribute name="wfFolderRuleCustomFieldName"> <AttrValue lang="default">Buying on Behalf Of 2</AttrValue> </Attribute> </Activity>
Adjust the dynamic workflow rules and approvers from th e following path: Site Configuration > Configure Documents > Manage Custom Fields > Custom Field - Values

In this example, Custom Field “Buying on Behalf Of” has a value of “test 1” where two dollar ranges are set. If a Requisition containing this custo m field value falls under [importo], no approval is necessary. If the same requisition is between [importo] and [importo], Matt Boge must approve it. If the requisition is greater than [importo], Aaron will need to approve it.

sections.title: Configuring Form Type Dynamic Workflow
paragraphs: Spend Director Specialization For Solutions Consultants
Last updated 6/23/2017 . JAGGAER Confidential. Copyright © 201 7, JAGGAER Page 4 | 12

Note that Form Type ADW workflow has all but replaced Form Type Dynamic Approval. ADW allows for individual Form Types as well as specific Form Names. Dynamic Form Type approval is more limiting because it is “all or n othing ” (any Form Type configured for workflow routing will require approval in one workflow step, typically called “Form Approval”). To Enable or Disable Form Type Dynamic Workflow for an organization go to the following location and ensure the setting, “Organiz ation uses Dynamic workflow for Form Types” is turned on: Site Configuration > Workflow Setup > General Workflow Settings > Workflow General

Once Form Types are available for Dynamic Workflow, Static Workflow will need to be written by JAGGAER or Part ner Support to allow for routing. Simple example of this static code: <Activity name="Form Approval"> <ActivityType>manual</ActivityType> <StepRef name=" Form Approval" /> <Rule><![CDATA[ Document.RequiresFormTypeApproval() == true ]]></Ru le> <FolderSelectionRule>FormType</FolderSelectionRule> </Activity>

Next, browse to the following location and configure your Dynamic Routing rules: Site Administration > Shopping Settings > Manage Form Types > Form Type In this example, any re quisition containing a Form Type: Business Card Request will be routed to the “Form Approval” workflow step and Aaron will need to approve it.

To Enable Department Dynamic Workflow for an organization go to the fol lowing location and ensure the setting, “Organization uses Dynamic workflow for Departments” is turned on: Site Configuration > Workflow Setup > General Workflow Settings > Workflow General

Once Departments are available for Dynamic Workflow, Static Wor kflow will need to be written by JAGGAER or Partner Support to allow for routing. Simple example of this static code: <Activity name="Department Approval"> <ActivityType>manual</ActivityType> <StepRef name=" Department Approval" /> <Rule><![ CDATA[ Document.RequiresDepartmentalApproval() == true ]]></Rule> <FolderSelectionRule>Department</FolderSelectionRule> </Activity>

Next, browse to the following location and configure your Dynamic Routing rules: Site Configuration > Organizati on Structure and Settings > Configure Departments And Positions > User Management - HR Configuration In this example, any requisition associated with the Organization -wide department called “01 New Department” will be routed to Aaron for approval.

Simple example of this static code: <Activity name= "Contract Approval"> <ActivityType>manual</ActivityType> <StepRef name=" Contract Approval" /> <Rule><![CDATA[ Document.RequiresContractTypeApproval() == true ]]></Rule> <FolderSelectionRule>Contract</FolderSelectionRule> </Activity>
